issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מֵבִין פְּתָיִים' means 'gives understanding to the simple' (i.e., the naive/inexperienced). The Chinese '使人明白愚昧人' reads as 'makes people understand the foolish person' (i.e., understanding the fool as an object), which reverses the object. The correct sense is that the entrance of God's words gives understanding to the simple (the naive), not that it makes one understand fools.
